t: Din aniyyat haqqaddish al yede haqqahal
s: Din aniyyat haqqaddish al yede haqqahal ubo ch' seipim: tzarik lizzaher meod baaniyyat haqqaddish (vehashshomea veeno oneh — hu benidduy m' yom). Veyesh lehishtaddel larutz lishmoa qaddish, sheqqedushshat haqqaddish gedola mikkol haqqedushshot, veyesh yoter mitzva baaniyyat haqqaddish mibbaaniyyat qedushsha. Umikkol maqom im yesh lepanayv b' bet hakkeneset, beechad maggiim leqaddish sheachar shemoneh esreh ubeechad maggiim liqdushsha — yelek veyaaneh qedushsha, ki sham yishma gam ken haqqaddish shelleachar shemoneh esreh:

Veyesh lekavven heteb be"amen yehe shemeh rabba", shekkol haoneh "amen yehe shemeh rabba" bekol koach kavvanato — qorein lo gezar dino shel shibim shana. Veyesh laanot oto beqol ram, sheqqol zeh shober kol hamqatregim umebattel kol gezerot qashot. Umikkol maqom lo yitten qolot gedolot, shello yitlotzetzu alayv bene adam veyigrom lahem chete:

"Yehe shemeh rabba mebarak lealam uleolme almayya" hu targum shel "yehi shemo haggadol meborak leolam uleoleme olamim", laken en lehapsiq ben "yehe shemeh rabba" li"mebarak", shello lehapsiq beemtza hammaamar. Umikkol maqom en tzarik lomar binshima achat. Vetzarik lomar "mebarak" hab' beqama"tz vehare"sh bepatta"ch, sheaz perusho kemo "meborak", sheim yomar re"sh betzere"y yihyeh perusho sheyyebarek laacherim. Vetzarik lomar "lealam" beqama"tz haayin. Veyesh lomar "uleolme" beva"v:

Mitzvat haqqaddish hu lishmoa min hashsheliach tzibbur "yitgaddal ku'", veal zeh yaaneh "amen yehe shemeh rabba", she"amen yehe shemeh rabba" hu aniyya al "yitgaddal ku'". Vetzarik lishmoa lekavven al mah hu oneh, kemo shetztzarik lekattechilla lishmoa ulekavven labberaka sheoneh alayv amen. Vegam hashsheliach tzibbur tzarik lomar gam ken (aysh"r) ["yehe shemeh rabba"] ku' kemo hatztzibbur. Umikkol maqom eno domeh legamre laaniyyat amen, shebbediabad im ba lebet hakkeneset keshehatztzibbur onin kebar "amen yehe shemeh rabba" — oneh immahem (aysh"r) ["yehe shemeh rabba"], hoil vehu shebach bipne atzmo, ap al pi sheomerim oto al "yitgaddal ku'". Abal lo yaaneh "amen yehe shemeh rabba", ella im ken yukal lekavven dato sheyyeda laanot al haqqaddish, sheaz enah amen yetoma bediabad ap al pi shello shama, kevan sheyyodea al mah hu oneh, kemo sheyyitbaer siman (qk"h) [qk"d]. Abal lekattechilla kesheepshar lo lishmoa — tzarik lishmoa, velo yismok al mah sheyyukal lekavven dato achar kak. Velaken yesh ligor behammesichim keshehashsheliach tzibbur omer haqqaddish, apillu kesheyyesh minyan biladam hashshomeim umekavvenim lashsheliach tzibbur. Veim en t' shomein lashsheliach tzibbur — lo yomar kelal qaddish, shekkol dabar shebbiqdushsha i epshar lomar bepachot mi' — t' shomein veechad omer. Veken tzarik lehazhir lehaomerim "veatta yigdal na vego' zakor vego'", sheyyomru qodem sheyyatchil hashsheliach tzibbur "yitgaddal" (ayyen siman s"v):

Yesh omerim sheen tzarik laamod kesheonin qaddish u"bareku", ella shekkol qaddish shettepaso meummad kegon shelleachar hallel — tob shello yesheb ad leachar sheyyaaneh "amen yehe shemeh rabba". Veyesh omerim sheyyesh laamod kesheoneh qaddish o kol dabar shebbiqdushsha, sheyyesh lilmod qal vachomer meeglon melek moab sheqqam meatzmo meal kiso ledibre Hashem, kol shekken anachnu ammo. Vetob lachosh ledibrehem (ayyen siman qm"v):

Yesh meqomot nohagin laanot amen achar "berik hu", shessoberim di"berik hu" chozer al "dequdsha", vehu targum shel haqqadosh baruk hu. Abal bimdinot ellu en mapsiqim kelal ben "berik hu" li"leella min kol birkata", shessoberim di"shemeh dequdsha" hu hepseq maamar u"berik hu leella ku'" hu inyan bipne atzmo. Umikkol maqom lo yapeh osim qetzat sheonin "berik hu leella" shehu kemo cherup, shemmashma sheeno meborak ella lemala velo lematta, ella yesh lahem lomar gam "min kol birkata ku'". Vegam lo yapeh osim hachazzanim shemmapsiqim beniggunam ben "mikkol" le"birkata" beshabbat veyom tob:

Paam achat matzeu eliyyahu zakur lattob veimmo d' alapim gemallim teunim, ameru lo: ma ellu teunim? Amar lahem: ap vechema, lamma? Amar lahem: laasot neqama beap vechema mimmi shemmesapper ben qaddish le"bareku", ben qedushsha liqdushsha, ben "qadosh" le"baruk", ben beraka libraka, ben pereq lepereq, ben "amen yehe shemeh rabba" le"yitbarek". Vekol hamdabber bahen — alayv neemar: "velo oti qarata vego'". Yesh lemedin mikkan shehaoneh "amen yehe shemeh rabba" — tzarik lomar gam "yitbarek" ad "daamiran bealma". Veyesh omerim sheyyotze yede chobato bemah sheshshomea mehashsheliach tzibbur, deshomea keoneh. Umah sheaseru ledabber ben "amen yehe shemeh rabba" le"yitbarek", im hashsheliach tzibbur hu maarik be"amen yehe shemeh rabba" vehu ana kebar — lo yesapper kelum qodem sheyyatchil hashsheliach tzibbur "yitbarek". Veod sheepshar shello hiqpid eliyyahu ella al tebat "yitbarek" bilbad shetztzarik leomrah ulehasmikah letebat "almayya", abal yoter en tzarik lomar ella lishmoa, kemo sheasur lomar "yitgaddal" im hashsheliach tzibbur ella tzarik lekavven velishmoa. Veken nohagin laanot ad "yitbarek". Uminhag yapeh hu, lepi shekkeshehashsheliach tzibbur omer bimhirut yitztarek hu lemaher yoter kede laanot amen acharayv vehammehirut mebattelet hakkavvana, laken mutab lishmoa:

Nohagin shehashsheliach tzibbur korea Hashem keriot baqqaddish: be"yitgaddal", ub"yehe shemeh rabba", ub"yitbarek", ubi"berik hu", ubeamen. Uleachar shessiyyem haqqaddish — nohagin lipsoa g' pesiot veachar kak omer "oseh shalom bimromayv", kemo besiyyum shemoneh esreh:
